means: An Animagine-specific quality bucket from the checkpoint own training recipe, derived from an aesthetic-scoring pass over the dataset rather than from any danbooru tag a human typed. It names a score band and nothing visible.
does: Pushes composition and colour toward whatever the aesthetic scorer rewarded - cleaner framing, more pleasing palettes, better-finished faces. Part of the measured load-bearing block. TWO HONEST CAVEATS: it is checkpoint-specific vocabulary, so it means nothing to a non-Animagine SDXL and nothing at all to Qwen; and like the rest of the block its individual contribution here has never been isolated.
reach_for_it: on the anime path, as part of the standard block. Drop it if you ever move off Animagine - carrying the block over unexamined spends tokens on a word the new model never learned.
used_in: the tail of every prompt in movies/derby-ep1.json and derby-qwen.json
